Name: Mage Cage
Overview:
Get ready for some MAGICAL MAYHEM with MAGE CAGE! Grab your friends and play as one of four students of sorcery, each with unique abilities, and demonstrate your magical prowess in this hectic platform fighter. Conjure your way through various levels as your spells bounce and burst in an attempt to become the most powerful wizard in the academy.
Mage Cage couples the competitive yet beginner friendly multiplayer of Super Smash Brothers with the fast-paced chaos of Multiplayer Pong. A cast of hilariously eccentric magic students fight to prove whose spells, and perhaps personality, is the best. Featuring 4 player local multiplayer, 5 maps with different tactical qualities, polished 3D art, 3 game modes, and AI for practicing your skills, this game gives you the chance to zap, burn, and freeze your enemies (or best friends)!
